page_title: FIO 1-2 CAG | Fiorentina v Cagliari 24/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+7' Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom right corner. However, David de Gea anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. Cagliari force their opponents to concede a corner.

90+7' The fans were almost celebrating as Michel Adopo (Cagliari) produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo run. The ball was heading towards the middle of the goal, but David de Gea made an astonishing save!
90+1' Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Guida had an easy-decision to make.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) takes a long run up and launches the free kick towards goal from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall bravely blocks the effort.
87' Jose Pedro (Cagliari) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
87' Jose Pedro (Cagliari) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Marco Guida blows his whistle for a foul. Fiorentina have a free kick from a promising distance.
87' Corner kicks – 8:2.

85' This is an obvious ploy to delay the restart of play from Yerry Mina (Cagliari). This is a yellow card! Yerry Mina (Cagliari) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
83' Substitution. Manor Solomon will be replaced by Niccolo Fortini (Fiorentina).
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) replaces Marco Palestra.
80' Fabio Pisacane has decided to make a change. Matteo Prati (Cagliari) replaces Luca Mazzitelli.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adam Obert departs the field of play to be replaced by Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari).
79' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
79' Giovanni Fabbian (Fiorentina) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the left post. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save.
79' Marco Brescianini (Fiorentina) gathers a nice lofted pass deep inside the box and attempts to put the ball inside the right post, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players.
76' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Marco Guida to decide it wasn’t offside. The relieved Fiorentina players can finally celebrate.
76' Wait! Referee Marco Guida has indicated he is going to review the Fiorentina goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
74' 1 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Dodo is the provider as he slips the ball to Marco Brescianini (Fiorentina) who simply steers it home from close range. It's 1:2.
73' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Manor Solomon (Fiorentina), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
72' Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
71' Substitution. Semih Kilicsoy is replaced by Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari).
70' Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

70' Dodo (Fiorentina) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Fiorentina will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
68' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but Elia Caprile comes off his line to gather the ball.
68' Total attempts – 8:8. The shots on goal statistics – 1:4.

66' What a great touch by Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina)! He picks up a precise pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot on goal. His effort, however, only rattles the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
66' Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
64' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Sebastiano Esposito as he is replaced by Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari).

63' Elia Caprile (Cagliari) obviously intended to delay the restart of play and the referee blows the whistle. Elia Caprile (Cagliari) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
62' Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
61' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is out of play. Fiorentina will take a throw-in.

60' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box. Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Elia Caprile intercepts the ball.
59' Paolo Vanoli has decided to substitute Cher Ndour and he is replaced by Jack Harrison (Fiorentina).
59' Substitution. Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) did his best and is replaced by Marco Brescianini.
59' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick to Fiorentina.
57' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) unloads a good strike from the free kick just outside the box. His effort towards the middle of the goal is stopped by David de Gea, who pulls off a glorious save!
56' Cagliari get the opportunity to endanger the opposition's goal with a free kick from the edge of the box.
56' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) was quite harsh and Marco Guida didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
53' A dangerous looking corner kick from Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) is cleared to safety by the defence.

53' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender. Now Cagliari have a corner.
51' Dodo (Fiorentina) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Elia Caprile, who smothers the ball.

49' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball zooms around the right post.

47' 0 - 2 GOAL! Sebastiano Esposito finds himself with the ball at his feet in space after a lightning counter attack. He looks and up slides the ball to Marco Palestra (Cagliari), who coolly slots the ball past the keeper from close in. It’s 0:2.
46' Half-time substitution. Paolo Vanoli decided to make a change. Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is replaced by Giovanni Fabbian.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) gets a shot from distance but fails to generate enough power to beat the goalkeeper.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' A pass from Marco Palestra (Cagliari) is intercepted by David de Gea and the move breaks down.
43' The resulting corner from Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is cleared by the defence.
43' Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. Fiorentina have a corner.
39' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
38' Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
34' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.

34' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Elia Caprile makes a great save to stop the effort going into the left side of the goal.
33' The resulting corner from Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
32' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
32' 3:3 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 0:1.
31' 0 - 1 Goal! Marco Palestra plays it to Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless David de Gea. 0:1.
29' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) attempts to release Sebastiano Esposito with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
26' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.

25' Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Marco Guida blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Fiorentina, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
24' Rolando Mandragora plays a nice corner into the middle of the box, Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) is first to react but his headed effort is way off the mark and goes well wide of the left post.
24' Corner kick. Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is ready to send the ball into the box.
24' Dodo (Fiorentina) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Fiorentina are awarded a corner kick.
22' Jose Pedro (Cagliari) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Marco Guida blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
20' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) sends a chip pass into the box, but Elia Caprile is quickest to intercept the ball.
19' A pass by Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
17' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
17' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. It's a free kick to Cagliari in a dangerous position.
16' The ratio of the ball possession is 78:22.
13' Marco Guida blows his whistle and signals a foul after Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) brought his opponent down. Fiorentina earn a free kick.
12' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies into the stands.
11' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) takes a short corner kick.
11' Cher Ndour loses the ball after receiving a sweet pass from Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina). Fiorentina will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
10' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) swings in a cross from the corner, but Elia Caprile reads it well and gathers the ball.
9' Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.
8' Jose Pedro (Cagliari) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
8' The referee awards a corner and Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) goes over to take it.
7' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Cagliari will take a corner.
6' Fiorentina seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
4' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) steps up and sends the mid-range free kick miles over the bar. Strong but inaccurate shot.
3' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Marco Guida signals. A free kick has been awarded to Fiorentina.
3' An attempted cross from Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) is cleared.
2' Dodo (Fiorentina) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
1' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Fiorentina will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Today's referee will be Marco Guida.
